svg.title: Let guests comment without letting them edit — SoftTrack web design mockup (#244)
svg.desc: A guest who is asked a question on a ticket cannot answer it, because commenting is a write like any other. A team setting lets guests comment, attach files to their comments and react, while every other control stays read-only, and the comment box says why it is the one thing that works.
svg.text: Let guests comment without letting them edit

svg.text: tests/test_guest_role.py lists the comment routes as reachable, with
the reason, and checks they are refused when the setting is off.
Done when a team setting, off by default, lets guests write, edit and delete their own comments, attach files to them and react; they still change nothing else; the comment box
shows for a guest only when the setting allows it; and tests/test_guest_role.py checks both states. Guests never see or write internal notes.
